english: Now there are three types of deeds which lead to a future experience through a process of ripening. These types of deeds themselves are grouped into two: they are either definite, or not. The "definite" group is of three different types, because it includes (1) those deeds with results that are experienced as "something seen"--that is, deeds which ripen into an experience in this very life; (2) deeds with results that are experienced after one's rebirth--that is, in the very next life; and (3) deeds with results that are experienced in "some other" life--which is to say, in any life after the next.
